title: Bound an integral by comparison
statement:
For every $x\in[1,5]$, suppose $1\le f(x)\le[$a]$. Find the largest possible value of $\int_1^5f(x)\,dx$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Multiply the height by the interval length.
The constant function with that height attains the bound.

feedback.message: The constant function with that height attains the bound.
